name: Vlad and Candies
justification: Neat max-vs-second-max criterion, trivial to code, clean YES/NO; n=1 edge case is the only trap.
solution_sketch: You must alternate away from the current max, so it's feasible iff max - secondmax <= 1 (alternate the top two, others absorb slack). For n=1 the answer is YES iff a_1 = 1.
